adjudication.rationale: The diff shows `spec/controllers/admin/embedding_controller_spec.rb` only contains a single example asserting `Admin::EmbeddingController < Admin::AdminController` (no requests, no JSON assertions). Meanwhile the PR introduces nontrivial behavior/contract: `Admin::EmbeddingController#show/#update` render `EmbeddingSerializer`, and `EmbeddingSerializer` uses `has_many :embeddable_hosts, ... embed: :ids`, relying on the Ember store’s new `_hydrateEmbedded` support for `*_ids` arrays. None of the new controller actions or the serializer payload shape that the Ember route (`admin/routes/admin-embedding.js.es6` calling `store.find('embedding')`) depends on are exercised by that spec, so the finding is accurate and diff-grounded as a missing-test/coverage concern rather than a proven runtime defect.
